# Coding Agent Directive: Build the "Steampunk Nebula Explorer" Landing Page

**Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Your task is to code a complete, production-quality landing page on the first attempt. Write **all user-facing copy in English**.

**Project Brief:**
- **Theme:** Steampunk Nebula Explorer — adventurous, industrial, imaginative retro-future / vintage sci-fi.
- **Keywords:** steampunk, space, nebula, gear, brass, copper, cosmic, vintage sci-fi, explorer style, cosmic industrial.
- **Brand persona:** "The Nebula Explorers' Guild" — a Victorian aether-travel bureau charting nebulae aboard brass skyships. All copy must adopt this adventurous, imaginative, industrial tone.
- **Visual language to render in pure CSS:** interlocking brass gears, copper piping, torn parchment containers, weathered paper grain, brushed bronze metal, cosmic void, nebula glow.
- **Page sections (in order):** Sticky Header/Nav, Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links.
- **Signature look (from the style spec — must be expressed via tokens and classes, never inlined):** `background-color: #0d1b33; color: #b5a642; font-family: 'Rye'; border: 2px solid #cd7f32; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #5d3a9b;`

---

## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS
- **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.
- **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states must be targeted via class or ID selectors defined in `style.css`.
- **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic (HTML5 landmarks: `header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`), and agnostic of visual styling — retheming the site must require editing only the CSS file.

### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
Store every visual token in `:root` (dark/cosmic defaults) and override in a `.light` theme class. Never hard-code hex values inside component rules.

**Dark theme — "Cosmic Void" (default, defined in `:root` and `.dark`):**

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--bg-primary` | `#0d1b33` | Cosmic void page background |
| `--bg-secondary` | `#16264a` | Cards, panels, header |
| `--bg-tertiary` | `#1d3055` | Hover surfaces, inputs |
| `--primary` | `#cd7f32` | Copper: primary buttons, links, signature borders |
| `--secondary` | `#b5a642` | Brass: headings, icons, focus rings |
| `--text-primary` | `#f2e8d3` | Starlight cream body text |
| `--text-secondary` | `#b5a642` | Brass secondary text |
| `--text-on-primary` | `#1c1208` | Text on copper fills |
| `--text-success` | `#8fce9e` | Verdigris patina |
| `--text-error` | `#e8705f` | Ember |
| `--border-default` | `#cd7f32` | Signature 2px copper frames (hairlines may use `rgba(205,127,50,.45)`) |
| `--border-success` / `--border-error` | `#8fce9e` / `#e8705f` | State borders |
| `--copper` / `--brass` / `--nebula` / `--star-white` | `#b87333` / `#b5a642` / `#5d3a9b` / `#ffffff` | Palette accents |
| `--glow-nebula` | `0 0 15px #5d3a9b` | Signature nebula glow |

**Light theme — "Workshop Parchment" (`.light` overrides):** `--bg-primary: #ece0c6` (aged parchment, never pure white); `--bg-secondary: #f5eeda` (use `#fefefe` only where a near-white surface is genuinely needed, e.g., input fills); `--bg-tertiary: #e2d3b2`; `--primary: #9c5a1f` (burnt copper, AA on parchment); `--secondary: #8a6d1d`; `--text-primary: #2b1d0e`; `--text-secondary: #6b4f2a`; `--text-on-primary: #fdf6e3`; `--text-success: #2e6b45`; `--text-error: #b23c2a`; `--border-default: #b87333`; `--glow-nebula: 0 0 12px rgba(93,58,155,.35)`.

**Shared tokens:** `--radius-sm: 2px; --radius-md: 6px; --radius-lg: 12px` (steampunk is angular — torn parchment cards may replace radius with `clip-path` edges); `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 6px rgba(4,10,24,.4)`; `--shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(4,10,24,.5)`; `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`; `--transition-fast: 150ms`; `--transition-normal: 300ms`; `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)`; `--z-header: 100`; `--z-dropdown: 1000`; `--z-modal: 2000`; `--z-toast: 3000`; `--font-display: 'Rye', serif`; `--font-base: 'Alegreya', serif`.

**Contrast Pairing (mandatory, both themes):** every light background token pairs with dark text, every dark background token pairs with light text. Verify WCAG AA (4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text and UI borders) in **both** themes; if a derived tone fails, adjust the derived tone — never the brand anchors above.

### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support
- **Dark-native design:** The Cosmic Void dark theme is the canonical, default presentation.
- **Implementation:** Define dark tokens in `:root`/`.dark` and parchment overrides in `.light`, applied as a class on `<html>`. Also set `color-scheme: dark` / `light` accordingly. Background and text variables must switch seamlessly with zero HTML restructuring.
- **Theme Switching:** Provide a visible toggle in the header using Google Material Symbols (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` (true when dark is active) and a descriptive `aria-label`.
- **Persistence:** Store the choice in `localStorage` (key `nebula-theme`); on first visit fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`, defaulting to dark when no preference exists.
- **Exception clause (theme-native dark):** because this theme is specified as full dark mode, dark is the brand default; the light "Workshop Parchment" variant exists to satisfy mandatory dual-theme accessibility, not to replace the canonical look.

### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment
- Build all layout structures with **Flexbox**. Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., form field stacks and long-form card text may use `stretch`/`flex-start` for readability).
- Mobile-first: card rows, pricing tiers, steps, and footer columns stack in a single column on small viewports and expand to multi-column rows at ≥768px. Prevent horizontal scrolling at every breakpoint (fluid `clamp()` typography, wrapping flex, `max-width` containers).

### 1.5 Styling Approach & Component Class API
- Use clean custom CSS organized in `@layer` blocks (`tokens`, `base`, `components`, `utilities`) — or Tailwind utilities mapped to the same tokens via `@layer`/`@apply` if preferred. Never mix approaches.
- Expose themed components as reusable classes: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.nav-link`, `.pricing-card`, `.faq-item`, `.toast`, `.modal`. All colors, radii, shadows, and motion must reference `var(--...)` tokens.

### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)
- **Text:** Load Google Fonts via `<link>` (with `preconnect`): **Rye** for display headings (`--font-display`) and **Alegreya** for body text (`--font-base`). Rye must never be used for body copy or long paragraphs.
- **Icons:** Use Google Material Symbols (Outlined) via the official `<link>`. Raw inline SVGs, local icon files, and emoji-as-icons are all forbidden.
- **Decorative CSS techniques (no images required):**
  - **Nebula backdrop:** layered `radial-gradient`s (`--nebula`, deep indigo) over `--bg-primary` with a vignette; optional slow drift animation.
  - **Star field:** pseudo-element layers of `box-shadow` star dots with staggered twinkle keyframes.
  - **Gears:** oversized Material Symbols `settings` glyphs in brass/copper at varying sizes/opacities with slow rotation (30–90s linear infinite), or pure-CSS gears via `repeating-conic-gradient` teeth + radial core.
  - **Copper piping:** bronze `linear-gradient` strips with rivet dots (`radial-gradient`) and elbow joints (bordered pseudo-elements) — used in the How It Works connector and section dividers.
  - **Torn parchment:** `clip-path: polygon(...)` irregular edges over parchment fills with weathered-grain overlay gradients; in dark mode, testimonial parchment stays cream (`#f0e4c8`) with `#2b1d0e` text for striking contrast.
  - **Brushed bronze:** fine `repeating-linear-gradient` micro-stripes overlaid on copper/brass fills (buttons, badges, medallions).
  - All decorative layers: `aria-hidden="true"`, `pointer-events: none`.

---

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

### 2.1 Button Component
- **Default:** `.btn` — `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px, uppercase letter-spaced label in `--font-base` 600. Variants: `.btn--primary` (copper fill + brushed texture + `--text-on-primary`), `.btn--brass` (2px brass outline, brass text), `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--danger` (ember — visually distinct in **both** themes).
- **Hover:** `brightness(1.1)` plus `box-shadow: var(--glow-nebula)`; `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** distinct `:focus-visible` ring — `outline: 2px solid var(--secondary); outline-offset: 2px`.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading (`.is-loading`):** sets `aria-busy="true"`, blocks pointer events to prevent double-clicks, and renders a CSS spinner or rotating Material `progress_activity` icon **without changing button dimensions** (reserve the icon slot).
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, `filter: grayscale(.6)`, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error (`.is-success` / `.is-error`):** temporary feedback driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`, always paired with an icon and text — never color alone.

### 2.2 Card Component
- **Default:** `.card` — flex column, `background: var(--bg-secondary)`, signature `border: 2px solid var(--border-default)`, `border-radius: var(--radius-md)` (or torn-parchment `clip-path` variant `.card--parchment`), `box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)`.
- **Hover (interactive cards):** `transform: translateY(-2px)`, `--shadow-md`, intensified nebula glow, corner gear rotation accent.
- **Focus-within:** border brightens to `--secondary` when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** `.card--skeleton` shimmer animation defined in CSS; reserved dimensions prevent layout jumps.
- **Empty State:** `.empty-state` fallback layout with a Material icon and clear guidance text.

### 2.3 Form & Input Requirements
- **Structure:** `.input-group` — flex container wrapping a `<label>`, the input, and a dedicated error feedback container (`.input-group__error`, `aria-live="polite"`, min-height reserved).
- **States (all styled via classes/pseudo-classes):** empty, focused (brass ring via `box-shadow`), filled, valid (success border + check icon), invalid (error border + error icon + message text), disabled, read-only. Error/success are never communicated by color alone.

### 2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements
- **States:** opening, open, loading, success/error, closing — all animated with CSS transitions (fade + scale).
- **UX:** centered flex container (`align-items: center; justify-content: center`), backdrop overlay (void + nebula tint), Material `close` icon button, keyboard focus trapping with focus returned to the trigger on close, close via `Esc` and overlay click, `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby`, body scroll locked while open.

### 2.5 FAQ Accordion
- Each item: `<button class="faq-item__trigger" aria-expanded aria-controls>` + panel (`role="region"`), animated via `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr`; Material `expand_more` chevron rotates 180°; fully keyboard operable.

### 2.6 Toast
- Fixed bottom-right, `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`, auto-dismiss after ~4s with close button, stacked at `--z-toast`.

---

## 3. LANDING PAGE SECTION BLUEPRINT

Write real, thematic English copy throughout — lorem ipsum is forbidden.

- **3.1 Header (sticky):** Guild logo (rotating CSS gear + wordmark), nav links (Features, The Expedition, Chronicles, Fares, FAQ), theme toggle, CTA `.btn--primary` "Book Passage". Collapses to an accessible hamburger menu (`aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`) below 768px. Include a "Skip to main content" link.
- **3.2 Hero:** full-viewport cosmic void with nebula gradients, twinkling stars, and interlocking rotating gears; eyebrow badge ("Est. 1889 — Aether Travel Bureau"), single `<h1>` in Rye (e.g., "Chart the Untamed Nebulae Aboard a Brass Skyship"), adventurous subcopy, dual CTAs ("Book Your Passage" → pricing; "View the Star Charts" → features), and a playful stats strip (nebulae charted, skyships afloat, expeditions returned).
- **3.3 Features (3 cards):** "Orrery Navigation" (icon `explore`), "Aether Propulsion" (icon `rocket_launch`), "Cartographer's Logbook" (icon `menu_book`) — each a `.card` with brass medallion icon, Rye title, and 2–3 sentences of copy; gear-corner accents.
- **3.4 How It Works (3 steps):** ordered list (`<ol>`) — 1. Calibrate the Orrery, 2. Board the Skyship, 3. Chart the Nebula. Step numbers sit in brass gear medallions connected by copper piping (horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile).
- **3.5 Testimonials (3 quotes):** torn-parchment `.card--parchment` quote cards with fictional explorers (e.g., "Captain Isadora Blackwood, Aether Navigator"), Material `star` ratings with accessible labels ("Rated 5 out of 5"), and brass avatar medallions.
- **3.6 Pricing (3 tiers):** Stowaway / Navigator (featured — brass double frame, nebula glow, "Most Popular" plaque) / Grand Explorer. Each `.pricing-card` lists features with check icons and a "Reserve Berth" button opening the modal. Include a monthly/annual segmented toggle (`role="radiogroup"`) — price updates are animated and announced via `aria-live="polite"`.
- **3.7 FAQ (5–6 items):** aether-travel safety, packing list, expedition duration, cancellations and refunds, accessibility aboard skyships, void weather.
- **3.8 Final CTA:** full-width nebula-glow band, Rye headline ("The Nebula Awaits, Explorer"), and the `.input-group` email signup — validate client-side (`novalidate` + custom logic): invalid → error state + `aria-live` message; valid → button loading → success state + inline confirmation + toast.
- **3.9 Footer:** brand column with tagline, three secondary link groups (Expedition, The Society, Support), social icon links with `aria-label`s, dynamic copyright year, legal links.

---

## 4. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by Default:** fluid `clamp()` sizing, breakpoints at 480/768/1024px, zero horizontal overflow at any width.
- **Smooth Animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)` on all state changes; gear rotation, star twinkle, nebula drift, shimmer, and scroll-reveal (IntersectionObserver adding `.is-visible`) must all be disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (also set `scroll-behavior: auto`); content must never stay hidden if JS fails.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** AA contrast in both Cosmic Void and Workshop Parchment modes; never rely on color alone; semantic HTML5 landmarks; correct ARIA on the toggle, mobile menu, accordion, modal, billing toggle, and ratings; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for form errors, loading, and toasts; `scroll-margin-top` on sections for the sticky header.
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, focus, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive Actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both themes.

---

## 5. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

- **File Structure:** separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks and no inline event handlers — only a single `<script src="script.js" defer></script>` entry point; all JS is vanilla (no external libraries) and uses `addEventListener`.
- **Naming Convention:** strict BEM throughout (`.btn--primary`, `.pricing-card__badge`, `.faq-item__trigger`) — never mix conventions.
- **Copy:** real, themed English copy for every section; placeholders are permitted only where content was genuinely unspecified by this brief.
- **Final QA (self-verify before delivering):** theme toggle persists across reloads; both themes pass contrast checks; all interactive states (hover/focus/active/loading/disabled/success/error) are styled; keyboard-only navigation reaches and operates every control; modal traps focus and closes via `Esc`; reduced-motion disables all decorative animation; no horizontal scroll from 320px upward; zero inline styles or inline SVGs.
